description: Environment inputs for the Sylphx migration CLI and its PostgreSQL proofs.

SYLPHX_MIGRATE_RUNTIME_ROLES.description: Optional comma-separated PostgreSQL login roles for migrate plan --release and migrate apply. Used only when --grant-runtime-role is absent. Omit the setting when no runtime roles are requested.

SYLPHX_MIGRATE_TEST_DATABASE_URL.description: Test-only admin connection URL for explicitly selected PostgreSQL proofs. Use only a local disposable trust-authenticated cluster; never set this to a live database.
